definitions.gloss: transfer of the capital; moving the capital to a new location
definitions.explanation: The act of relocating the national capital from one city to another. A key concept in Japanese history, where the capital was moved multiple times.

examples.japanese: 794⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{遷都|せんと}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The capital was moved to Kyoto in 794.

examples.japanese: {遷都|せんと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧さまざまな⟦{説|せつ}→説：00360_setsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are various theories about the reasons for moving the capital.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明治|めいじ}→明治：19860_meiji⟧⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遷都|せんと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決定|けってい}→決定：02701_kettei⟧し、⟦{天皇|てんのう}→天皇：04546_tennou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{移|うつ}った→移る：01232_utsuru⟧。
examples.english: The Meiji government decided to transfer the capital to Tokyo, and the Emperor moved from Kyoto to Tokyo.

notes:
USAGE: {遷都|せんと} is used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a verb. It appears primarily in historical and political contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- A⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{遷都|せんと}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to move the capital to A)
- A⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧B⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遷都|せんと} (the transfer of the capital from A to B)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遷都|せんと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ (to carry out the capital transfer)
- {遷都|せんと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧ (a plan to move the capital)

Japan's major capital transfers include the move to ⟦{奈良|なら}→奈良：27451_nara⟧ (710), to ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧ (794, known as {平安京|へいあんきょう}), and to ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧ (1868). The topic of ⟦{首都|しゅと}→首都：03224_shuto⟧⟦{移転|いてん}→移転：04000_iten⟧ (capital relocation) has been debated in modern Japanese politics as well.
